registration: Recorded before reading continuation outcomes or computing combined performance comparisons. Selection is based on completed paired cells and contender-order balance, not timing results.
challengerIdentity: Reconstructed verified patch postimages; not the unavailable original historical commit object

modes.C: warm same-document replay with budget-limited decoded cache
modes.E: explicit page-network offline after preparation; request attempts invalidate coverage

cohorts.excluded: Baseline-only A-mode trial 5 has no matching challenger receipt.

pairing: Only same original runId + original trial + cache mode + physical profile. Derived comparison-input trial indices are unique within each mode; original identifiers, paths and SHA256 remain attached. Raw receipts are never renumbered or overwritten.
eligibility: Only matched PASS receipts enter performance estimates. All FAIL and NOT RUN receipts remain published; failures and exclusions are reported separately. Invalid offline timings never enter a speed comparison.
estimation: Reuse scripts/lab/compare.mjs: candidate-minus-baseline paired differences, nearest-rank median, 10000 seeded bootstrap resamples (seed 53), 95% CI and baseline MAD. Beyond noise requires CI excluding zero and absolute median difference greater than baseline MAD.
scopeLimits: Cohort interruption and owned-anchor cleanup are explicit; this is not one uninterrupted hardware window.
The controller and local asset servers run on the phone; their overhead is not calibrated.
rAF and browser-event latency are JS observations, not GPU completion or input-to-photon measurements.
Secure incognito native screenshots cannot provide native pixel acceptance; settled owned-page CDP captures are a separate diagnostic.
Unproven transient pixels, source pops, hardware input latency and GPU memory remain null with reasons.
Neither the production baseline nor the previously verified software lab incumbent is promoted, merged or silently replaced.
